title: Home near Old Hickory Lake
description:
Relax with the whole family at this peaceful place to stay. Fire pit for roasting marshmallows and lots of seating outside to have a BBQ with blackstone grill. Plenty of parking in driveway. Spacious dining room which is open to the newly remodeled kitchen.   

There is a studio apartment over the garage with its own entrance that may be occupied. There is an electronic door between the main house and garage so you will have privacy as well as the person in studio apartment.
